name: BUS 2 - second RS-485 segment (second Nano on /dev/ttyACM1)
info:
Slice 10 two-segment RS-485.

The Nano firmware drives ONE RS-485 port, so a second segment is a second
Nano on its own serial port with its own compiled job.

Inbound: serial in -> Tag Bus2 -> the SAME shared decode/UI/Data-Out chain as
bus1. Sharing is safe because the decode pipeline keys sensorData by unit
address and the commissioning UI forces addresses unique across ALL buses.

Outbound: Send Nano Job (bus2) -> json -> serial out. It ignores a resend
carrying msg.busId for another segment, so a bus1-only config change never
re-inits this Nano's Modbus timeout.

Each segment has its OWN 30s serial-silence watchdog: bus2 traffic must not
keep bus1's watchdog alive, or a dead bus1 would look healthy.
